mutations.id: F01 the page collapses an unread flag back to false
mutations.expect: does not tell a manager the export flag is off when the flag was never read

mutations.id: F02 approveAvailability stops distinguishing unread from off
mutations.expect: withholds it while the stage flag is UNREAD

mutations.id: F03 exportAvailability stops distinguishing unread from off
mutations.expect: withholds EXPORT on an unread flag

mutations.id: F04 the panel prop defaults back to a flag it was never told about
mutations.expect: says the switch is unread, not off, when it was never told about the switch

mutations.id: F05 the unread sentence is the flag-off sentence
mutations.from: wft_gate_flag_unread: 'Vi vet ikke om eksport er slått på for denne butikken. Dette betyr ikke at den er av.',
mutations.to: wft_gate_flag_unread: 'Eksport er slått av for denne butikken.',
mutations.expect: does not tell a manager the export flag is off when the flag was never read

mutations.id: F06 an undefined flag is treated as an answered one
mutations.expect: withholds it while the stage flag is UNREAD (undefined)

mutations.id: F07 the flag-off banner stops distinguishing unread from off
mutations.expect: flag-off banner is shown only once the server has actually answered

mutations.id: F08 an answered off flag is softened into unread
mutations.expect: still says so, and is not softened
